name: Wandering Wolf, Champion of Lambholt, Kraken of the Straits — 'creatures with power less than …' can't block, judged on P/T after layer 7
notes: Memory: project_source_compared_subjects_judged_after_layer_7_2026-10-16. The blocking rules were applied in layer 6, so both sides' power was read before layer 7: Glorious Anthem and +1/+1 counters were not counted. They are now judged after layer 7. Wolf 3/2 with the Anthem: Grizzly Bears (2) can't block it. Champion 4/4 (two counters and the Anthem): every creature but itself has less power, so none of them can block Player 1's creatures, and the Champion no longer can't block the Wolf. Kraken with three Islands: Grizzly Bears (2) can't block it, Gray Ogre (3 with its counter) can.

scryfallData.name: Grizzly Bears
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"We cannot forget that among all of Dominaria's wonders, a system of life exists, with prey and predators that will never fight wars nor vie for ancient power."
—Jolrael, empress of beasts

scryfallData.name: Hill Giant
scryfallData.flavor_text: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

scryfallData.name: Gray Ogre
scryfallData.flavor_text: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, preferring to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

scryfallData.name: Wandering Wolf
scryfallData.oracle_text: Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block it.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Humans still feared wolves, though no connection between them and the curse of lycanthropy had ever been proved.

scryfallData.name: Champion of Lambholt
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Creatures with power less than this creature's power can't block creatures you control.
Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

scryfallData.name: Kraken of the Straits
scryfallData.oracle_text: Creatures with power less than the number of Islands you control can't block this creature.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Thassa felt no need to punish the sailors for their folly in crossing the straits. The kraken would do it for her.

scryfallData.name: Glorious Anthem
scryfallData.flavor_text: The songs of angels are perceived not as words in the ears but as stirrings in the soul.
